outcome: Changes in umbilical artery flow velocity waveform (FVW)
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with fetal growth retardation (FGR) and impaired umbilical artery FVW who were eligible for betamethasone administration.
finding: Betamethasone administration improved umbilical artery FVW in pregnancies with FGR, as evidenced by reduced PI and RI, while no association was found between AFI and betamethasone administration.
